name: Soma Web Novel
description: An East African localized web novel platform featuring rich story discovery, bilingual reading modes in English & Kiswahili, custom reader customization, and AI story assistant.

published_books.title: I Returned on the Day of Division
published_books.author: Safiya Amani
published_books.description: A 1980s Kenyan woman stands against family exploitation on the day of property division and builds an independent agricultural empire.
published_books.description_sw: Hadithi ya mwanamke wa Kenya wa miaka ya 1980 anayesimama dhidi ya dhuluma za kifamilia siku ya mgawanyo wa mali na kujenga milki ya kibiashara.

published_books.title: I Returned Before the Wedding
published_books.author: Nia Kendi
published_books.description: Trapped in a burning warehouse on the eve of her husband's secret wedding, Zawadi uncovers a cold-blooded insurance betrayal—and returns to reclaim her life and company.
published_books.description_sw: Akinaswa katika ghala linaloungua moto siku moja kabla ya harusi ya siri ya mume wake, Zawadi anagundua usaliti wa bima—na anarudi kudai maisha na kampuni yake.

published_books.title: Container Forty-Seven
published_books.author: Safiya Amani
published_books.description: When a refrigerated medicine shipment reaches Mombasa with its cold chain broken, port auditor Mariam Bakari follows a fake electronic seal into a dangerous logistics conspiracy.
published_books.description_sw: Shehena ya dawa za baridi inapowasili Mombasa ikiwa imeharibika, mkaguzi Mariam Bakari anafuata saini ya uongo ya kielektroniki ndani ya njama hatari ya usafirishaji.
